questions.q: What is universal adult franchise, and why is it important for democracy?
answer: Universal adult franchise is the right of every adult citizen to vote, regardless of caste, religion, gender, wealth or education.

answer.text: In India, every citizen aged eighteen or above can vote, the age having been lowered from twenty-one by the 61st Constitutional Amendment in 1988.
It rests on the principle of political equality — one person, one vote, one value — so that a poor labourer's vote counts exactly as much as that of a wealthy person.

By giving everyone an equal say in choosing the government, universal adult franchise makes the government truly representative and accountable to all the people, which is the very heart of democracy.

questions.q: What is the role of the Election Commission of India?
answer: The Election Commission of India is an independent constitutional body responsible for conducting elections in the country.

answer.text: It conducts elections to Parliament, the State legislatures and the offices of the President and Vice-President. It prepares and updates the electoral rolls, or voter lists, decides the schedule of elections, and oversees the whole process, now conducted through Electronic Voting Machines with VVPAT.
It enforces the Model Code of Conduct, which lays down rules that parties and candidates must follow during campaigns, and takes action against violations.
Its independence from the government is essential, for only an impartial Election Commission can ensure free and fair elections, the foundation of democracy.
